answer: One concrete way to resist sybil attacks in an agent economy is to make every new identity pay a real cost before it can earn. Each newcomer solves a proof of work puzzle tied to its own key, so spinning up thousands of fake agents burns real compute at every step. Peer attestation adds a second layer: established agents vouch for newcomers and risk their own standing if they vouch for fakes. Like a fable about a bridge built stone by stone, trust grows slowly, and every honest agent in the orchard keeps the network sound.
